Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating mortgage lenders and credit card issuers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to mortgage lenders and credit card issuers; andadding a new chapter to Title 19 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Mortgage lenders doing business inWashington state shall prominently display on their statements toconsumers: (1) A valid mailing address for consumers to use in contacting thebusiness; and (2) A telephone number that enables a consumer to talk to a liveperson, in the event that voice mail selections fail to resolve theconsumer's issues or adequately answer the consumer's questions. Thetelephone number that connects to a live person must, at a minimum, bestaffed during regular business hours.

Credit card issuers doing business inWashington state shall prominently display on their statements toconsumers: (1) A valid mailing address for consumers to use in contacting thebusiness; and p. 1 SB 6584 (2) A telephone number that enables a consumer to talk to a liveperson, in the event that voice mail selections fail to resolve theconsumer's issues or adequately answer the consumer's questions. Thetelephone number that connects to a live person must, at a minimum, bestaffed during regular business hours.
Sections 1 and 2 of this act constitute anew chapter in Title 19 RCW.
